newsitem.title: ITALY: Republic Italy places $1.5 bln on German debt mart.
newsitem.headline: Republic Italy places $1.5 bln on German debt mart.

text.p: The Republic of Italy has completed a private placement of $1.5 billion on the German debt (Schuldschein) market with an duration of 16 years and a put option at the eighth year, the Italian Treasury said in a statement.
The Treasury said the transaction had allowed the Republic to obtain a global interest rate of 5.985 percent for the first eight years and 6.189 percent for the entire duration.
The placement was managed by JP Morgan, it said.
